subject: English
passage: Some virtual reality systems such as OculusVR (developed in 2012) and HTC Vive (developed in 2016) incorporate realistic environmental features like spatial audio cues and depth perception so that users will find it easier to navigate virtual spaces. While these features can help to ______ feelings of ease in users, a VR environment that mimics reality too precisely can trigger sensory conflict, meaning that the excessive realism unintentionally causes disorientation in those who experience it.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer because it most logically completes the text's discussion of VR design features. In this context, 'foster' means to promote or encourage the development of something. The text establishes that VR systems incorporate realistic features like spatial audio cues and depth perception specifically so that users 'will find it easier to navigate virtual spaces.' These design elements are intended to create positive user experiences by making navigation more intuitive. Features that successfully make navigation easier would naturally foster, or promote, feelings of ease in users by facilitating their movement through virtual environments.
